item.title: President Trump awards big tech donors with nation’s highest science prizes
item.dc:creator: Dominic-Madori Davis
item.description: On Thursday, President Trump awarded Elon Musk, Jensen Huang, Sergey Brin, and AMD’s Lisa Su the National Medal of Science, the nation’s top science prize.

item.title: Pretend you’re sitting at Elizabeth Holmes’ desk on this weirdly detailed website
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: With over a thousand emails, slides, texts, and documents from the United States v. Elizabeth Holmes trial, Extend engineer Bo Lau created a website that simulates what it might have been like to rifle through the Theranos founder's desk.

item.title: Fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute misconduct claims, warn of chilling effect
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Bellan
item.description: Three fired OpenAI safety researchers dispute allegations of mishandling sensitive information, warning in an open letter that their dismissals are creating a chilling effect on the company’s AI safety culture.

item.title: Watch the trailer for ‘The Altruists,’ Netflix’s show about the FTX scandal
item.dc:creator: Amanda Silberling
item.description: A fictionalized Sam Bankman-Fried is coming to your TV screen on November 19.

item.title: Ben Affleck is an AI nerd, and the internet is impressed
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Ben Affleck is going viral for his deep knowledge of AI, from neural networks and transformers to open weights. The actor, who sold his AI filmmaking startup to Netflix earlier this year, is proving he's more than just a Hollywood star.

item.title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months
item.dc:creator: Julie Bort
item.description: The company behind the popular LMArena leaderboard has raised $200 million led by Lightspeed and Khosla, and is now measuring AI models on alignment issues such as lying.

item.title: OpenAI’s revenue is reportedly $20 billion less than previously projected
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: It had previously been reported that the AI lab's annualized revenue was some $70 billion, but a new report claims it's a whole lot less than that.

item.title: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

item.title: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
item.dc:creator: Russell Brandom
item.description: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.

item.title: OpenAI’s math solutions aren’t meeting the field’s standards yet
item.dc:creator: Tim Fernholz
item.description: OpenAI's flood of proofs deviated from the guidelines set by a group of mathematical researchers consulted by the frontier lab.

item.title: A startup founder who served time in prison is looking to court an untapped market: ex-cons
item.dc:creator: Lucas Ropek
item.description: Richard Bronson, a former Stratton Oakmont partner who served time in federal prison for securities violations, has launched Commissary Club, a startup that uses AI to help people leaving prison find jobs, housing, community, and even dates.

item.title: Natura’s $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: Natura’s $99 Interface smart ring lets you summon AI agents with the press of a finger to complete tasks, capture thoughts, and control devices — while doubling as a health tracker.

item.title: Goodfire says its new ‘inside-out’ monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
item.dc:creator: Aditya Mehta
item.description: Goodfire just launched what it says is a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check: Instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, its monitors peek inside the model while it works and only call in backup when something looks fishy.

item.title: US bars Microsoft, Adobe, and major IT firms from green card program for skilled foreign workers
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: The other firms being suspended from the program include Capgemini, Cognizant, HCL, Infosys, Tata, and Wipro.

item.title: Elon Musk questions Ambani’s influence as Starlink India launch stalls
item.dc:creator: Jagmeet Singh
item.description: “Is Ambani the real boss of India?” Elon Musk asked as he questioned why Starlink has yet to launch its satellite internet service in the country.

item.title: New York alleges TikTok gave teens, children a placebo safety feature instead of a real one
item.dc:creator: Aisha Malik
item.description: New York’s lawsuit against the company is one of more than two dozen cases brought by states accusing the social media giant of designing its platform to encourage addictive use among children.

item.title: Asos confirms breach of customer data after hackers send rogue app notification
item.dc:creator: Zack Whittaker
item.description: The hackers alerted the fashion giant's customers through a push notification that said they had "fully compromised" the company's cloud storage.

item.title: Hear from Ambrosia Energy and Bloom Energy execs on where the AI infrastructure boom is creating opportunity at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
item.dc:creator: TechCrunch Events
item.description: Ambrosia Energy CEO Ben Longmier and Bloom Energy SVP Bill Thayer join the Smart Systems Stage at TechCrunch Disrupt. Register now to save up to $100. Grab a second of the same pass to save 50%.

item.title: Spotify is getting more serious about selling enterprise software
item.dc:creator: Sarah Perez
item.description: The company launched technology.spotify.com, a new site that will make its internal tech available to outsiders.

item.title: Waymo locks in $5B loan from Blackstone, PIMCO to fuel robotaxi expansion
item.dc:creator: Kirsten Korosec
item.description: This is the first time the Alphabet-owned company has turned to debt financing.
